ddl.value: ("action" IN ('ACCOUNT_CREATED', 'ACCOUNT_UPDATED', 'ACCOUNT_ARCHIVED', 'PASSWORD_RESET', 'PERIOD_CREATED', 'PERIOD_EXTENDED', 'PERIOD_ASSIGNED', 'ACCOUNT_PERMISSION_GRANTED', 'ACCOUNT_PERMISSION_REVOKED') AND "actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("action" = 'SYSTEM_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAPPED' AND "actor_user_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: account_audit_logs_action_check

ddl.value: ("action" = 'MANUAL_CREATED' AND "before_state" IS NULL) OR ("action" = 'ATTENDANCE_CORRECTED' AND "before_state" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_audit_logs_action_state

ddl.value: "source" <> 'MANUAL' OR ("manual_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("manual_reason")) > 0)
ddl.name: attendance_records_manual_reason

ddl.value: ("source" = 'QR' AND "scan_lat" IS NOT NULL AND "scan_lng" IS NOT NULL AND "gps_accuracy_m" IS NOT NULL AND "scan_lat" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "scan_lng" BETWEEN -180 AND 180 AND "gps_accuracy_m" > 0 AND "gps_accuracy_m" < 'Infinity'::double precision) OR ("source" = 'MANUAL' AND "scan_lat" IS NULL AND "scan_lng" IS NULL AND "gps_accuracy_m" IS NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_records_gps_package

ddl.value: ("status" = 'INACTIVE' AND "activated_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'CLOSED' AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: attendance_sessions_lifecycle

ddl.value: ("snapshot_committee_division" IS NULL AND "snapshot_committee_position" IS NULL) OR ("snapshot_committee_division" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("snapshot_committee_division")) > 0 AND "snapshot_committee_position" IS NOT NULL AND "snapshot_committee_position" IN ('ANGGOTA', 'SEKDEP', 'KADEP', 'SEKRE', 'BENDAHARA', 'PIC1', 'PIC2', 'PJ'))
ddl.name: event_participants_committee_snapshot

ddl.value: ("organization_context" = 'SR' AND "committee_id" IS NULL AND "snapshot_committee_name" IS NULL) OR ("organization_context" = 'COMMITTEE' AND "committee_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: events_organization_context

ddl.value: ("snapshot_committee_name" IS NULL OR length(btrim("snapshot_committee_name")) > 0) AND ("organization_context" <> 'COMMITTEE' OR "status" = 'DRAFT' OR "snapshot_committee_name" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: events_committee_snapshot

ddl.value: ("status" = 'DRAFT' AND "published_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'PUBLISHED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("status" = 'CLOSED' AND "published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: events_lifecycle

ddl.value: ("revoked_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "revoked_at" >= "granted_at")
ddl.name: user_permission_grants_revocation_check

ddl.value: ("before_state" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("before_state") = 'object') AND ("after_state" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("after_state") = 'object')
ddl.name: violations_audits_state_object_valid

ddl.value: length(btrim("student_name")) > 0 AND length(btrim("student_nim")) > 0 AND length(btrim("description")) > 0 AND length(btrim("recorded_building_name")) > 0 AND length(btrim("ktm_object_key")) > 0 AND length(btrim("ktm_content_type")) > 0
ddl.name: violations_reports_required_text_nonblank

ddl.value: ("deleted_at" IS NULL AND "deleted_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "delete_reason" IS NULL) OR ("deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "deleted_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(length(btrim("delete_reason")), 0) > 0)
ddl.name: violations_reports_delete_metadata_consistent

ddl.value: ("consumed_at" IS NULL AND "result_object_key" IS NULL) OR ("consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "result_object_key" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: violations_upload_intents_consumption_consistent
